name: New York Woodworking
old_description: New York Woodworking is dedicated to designing, fabricating and creating the finishing touches that make your home special to you.
about:
Based in Ronkonkoma, New York, New York Woodworking operates as a custom woodworking shop specializing in architectural millwork and cabinetry. The company focuses on designing, fabricating, and installing finishing details for residential and commercial spaces.

The shop produces a range of millwork including custom cabinetry for kitchens, dining rooms, and bathrooms; entertainment centers and built-ins; archways, moldings, coffered ceilings, wainscot paneling, and mantles. It also offers commercial millwork packages. The work encompasses design through fabrication, with services packaged for new construction and remodeling projects.

Customers include homeowners, builders, and commercial contractors seeking tailored woodwork for interior spaces. Projects referenced on the company’s site span kitchen and bath renovations, dining room installations, and commercial fit-outs, indicating a client base across residential remodeling and light commercial construction.

The firm states its dedication to creating the finishing touches that make a home special to the owner, emphasizing attentiveness and professionalism throughout the project lifecycle.
